paragraphs.text: From the place where I was banished, being driven out of the city and temple by my son Absalom.
paragraphs.label: a
paragraphs.anchor: the end of the earth will

paragraphs.text: To which without your help I cannot attain.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: There is nothing that strengthens our faith more than the memory of God's help in times past.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: This chiefly refers to Christ, who lives eternally not only in himself but also in his members.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: For the stability of my kingdom stands in your mercy and truth.
paragraphs.label: e
